items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: Dan Fornero was on a session the other day... Dan Fornero’s been playing a little bit [in the Jerry Hey Horns]

ctx.x: Yeah so Dan Fornero was on a session the other day and he sang that [scats]. And I said, “You know there’s this ghosted note.” And he goes, “No!” I said, “Yeah.”
Well I used to have to play that on a synthesizer in a band and believe me, I didn’t get the ghosted note.
